analysis.test_infrastructure: None. The project has zero test files anywhere in the repository. No jest.config, vitest.config, playwright.config, or cypress.config. No devDependencies include any test runner or assertion library. The only test-related artifact in package.json is an unrelated reference in the FAQ copy ('152 end-to-end tests' describing Andamio's platform, not this repo's suite).

behavioral_changes_in_diff.V2FAQSection: The accordion toggle logic (useState + toggle function) is unchanged. The state machine is: null -> index on first click, index -> null on second click of same item, index -> different_index on click of different item. This logic was carried over verbatim from the pre-refactor version. No behavioral change introduced.
behavioral_changes_in_diff.all_other_components: Pure presentational changes: framer-motion wrappers removed or simplified, CSS class strings changed, eyebrow labels removed, text arrows removed, SVG icon components deleted, split-color h2 spans collapsed to plain text. No state, no event handlers, no conditional data-fetching, no API calls added or changed.

analysis.untested_branches_in_new_code: None introduced. The only conditional logic in the diff is the ChevronIcon open prop (class toggle) and the stackLayers emphasis flag (class toggle) -- both are CSS-only conditions with no state side-effects. The accordion toggle function was not modified.
analysis.V2FAQSection_accordion_coverage_check: No test exists for V2FAQSection's useState accordion before or after this diff. The accordion has three meaningful branches: (1) click closed item opens it, (2) click open item closes it, (3) click different open item switches which is open. None are covered. However, this is pre-existing tech debt -- the accordion existed before this diff and the diff does not change its logic. The diff is not the origin of the gap.
analysis.verdict: The diff introduces no new behavioral branches and adds no tests. Because the entire project has no test infrastructure, and the changes are purely presentational (class strings, markup structure, motion wrappers), there are no testable behavioral regressions introduced by this diff that could be caught by tests that don't yet exist. The one component with real interactive logic (V2FAQSection accordion) is unchanged in behavior. No manufacturable findings.

residual_risks.description: V2FAQSection contains a three-branch accordion state machine (open, close, switch) with no test coverage at any level. If the toggle logic were ever refactored, there is no safety net. This is pre-existing debt not introduced by this diff.
residual_risks.actionable: Add a component test using @testing-library/react verifying: click opens item, second click closes it, clicking a second item closes first and opens second.

testing_gaps.description: The repository has no test runner configured (no jest, vitest, playwright, or cypress) and no test files. V2FAQSection is the only component in the changed set with interactive state. Its accordion toggle logic is not covered and cannot be covered until a test runner is installed.
